# U170: A gap in measurement is visible and owned (MS): as Rhea, Flaky test rate is said to be a Gap with what is missing; its page shows the square Gap mark and, under To sort out, “Not measured yet: 1 goal held to no number”; its goal says “Not measured yet” with its own status shape, on its page and in the Goals list filtered to that status, nothing due on it. Said to be Measured again, the goal is held to its plan once more

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-MEASUREMENT`
- **Budget:** at most 24 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/metrics/metric_flaky-rate/edit` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U170

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/metrics/metric_flaky-rate/edit` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Is it measured today” group shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) scored as met here.
- **Step.** Press the “Gap” button in the “Is it measured today” group.
- **Step.** Type “The new runners send no results yet; Aiko is adding them.” into the “What’s missing” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/metrics/flaky-rate(? / # / $)” in the demo.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** “Not measured yet: 1 goal held to no number” is shown in the metric sortout (`.metric-sortout`) (else: To sort out does not list the gap and its goal).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the metric page does not show the Gap shape and word.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “gap said”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Go to `/goals/lead-flaky` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Not measured yet” is shown in the goal’s summary bar (else: the goal does not say it is held to no number).
- _Note:_ Its own status, shape and word (Lane, 14 Nov), on its page and in the Goals list, never No check-in yet.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if the goal’s Not measured yet has no status shape of its own.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&status=unmeasured` in the demo.
- **Check:** The status shape in the main (`main .status-shape[data-status="unmeasured"]`) shows.
- **Check:** “Not measured yet” is shown (else: the Goals list does not say the goal is Not measured yet).
- _Note:_ The Board has a lane for it, as for every status (#510 review), with the held goal's card in it.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=board&status=unmeasured` in the demo.
- **Check:** {title} is shown in the “Not measured yet, 1” section (else: the Board has no Not measured yet lane with the held goal’s card).
- _Note:_ Said to be measured again: the goal is held to its plan once more.
- Go to `/metrics/metric_flaky-rate/edit` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Measured” button in the “Is it measured today” group.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/metrics/flaky-rate(? / # / $)” in the demo.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if {worked out in the journey as `!g?.unmeasuredSince ? 'the gap did not hold the goal to no number' : 'Measured again did not let go of the goal'`}.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
